heuristics.memory: weights + 2 x layers x kv heads x head size x 2 bytes per token of context + compute (120 MB + vocab x 1 KB + 40 KB per token) + 350 MB runtime reserve; see estimate.js
heuristics.giant: needs more than 16 GB at 4096 tokens
heuristics.quality: rounded reading of the published model cards and leaderboards for the Q8_0 file, lowered per quantization (see quantQuality) and more for small models; a ranking aid, not a measurement
heuristics.speedClass: fast: up to 4B parameters per token, medium: up to 9B, slow: up to 16B, very_slow: more
